What does it cost to install carpet in a Mill Creek home?

Figure $4–$7 per square foot installed in Mill Creek, covering carpet, pad, labor, new tack strip and haul-away. One bedroom typically runs $600–$1,000, a full staircase $235–$400, and a common Mill Creek project — three bedrooms plus the stairs — lands around $2,400–$3,900. Carpet grade swings the total more than any other choice, and you make that choice with samples laid out in your own rooms.
Does the mobile carpet showroom come to Mill Creek?

Yes — Mill Creek sits squarely in our service area. The van shows up with 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades, we lay them in the rooms being carpeted so the color gets judged in your light instead of a store's, then measure everything and write your price before the visit ends. There's no store to drive to, and the appointment costs you nothing.
What does carpet restretching cost in Mill Creek?

Restretching in Mill Creek starts at $99 per room, with most rooms landing between $99 and $180. A power stretcher pulls wrinkles, waves and lifted edges back out for about a fifth of what replacement would cost. If the pile hasn't matted down and the color still suits the room, stretching is the better spend.
What do carpeted stairs cost in Mill Creek?

Stair carpet starts at $18 per step, installed waterfall or cap-and-band. A typical Mill Creek staircase totals $235–$400, and landings or pie-shaped winders are measured into the written quote from day one instead of turning up later as an extra charge.
How long does a Mill Creek carpet install take?

One day covers most Mill Creek homes. A few bedrooms, the hall and a staircase make a comfortable single day for our crew; a furnished whole-house job can carry into a second. Your written quote spells out the schedule, so you know before install day arrives.
Will your crew move my furniture, or do I clear the rooms?

We take the big pieces. Beds, dressers, couches and tables get moved by the crew and set back where they belong, included on most jobs. You look after the small things — closet floors, lamps, electronics and anything breakable you'd rather carry yourself.
Should I restretch the carpet in my Mill Creek two-story or replace it?

Restretch when the carpet is still healthy — pile upright, backing sound, a color you can live with. That's a repair from $99 per room instead of a full replacement. Replace when traffic lanes are crushed flat, seams are failing, the backing is breaking down, or pet odor has survived a professional cleaning. We call it straight before any quote gets written.

All of Mill Creek — the original streets around the country club, Town Center, East Mill Creek and the villages between — plus Silver Firs, Seattle Hill, Silver Lake, Martha Lake, Mays Pond, North Creek, Thrashers Corner and Murphys Corner. We also run regular routes through Bothell, Lynnwood, Everett and the rest of south Snohomish County.
What carpet handles dogs and cats best?

Solution-dyed nylon over a moisture-barrier pad, with a sealed backing. The barrier pad and sealed backing keep accidents out of the subfloor — the source of odor that never leaves — and solution-dyed fiber shrugs off strong cleaners, even diluted bleach, without losing color. The moisture-barrier pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot and earns its keep in nearly every pet household.
What warranty comes with the install?

Two layers. OC Flooring covers the workmanship — seams, stretch, transitions — with a 1-year warranty, and the mill covers the carpet itself, usually 10 to 25 years against wear and stains depending on grade. Both go on your written quote. Worth knowing: mills can tie their coverage to pad quality, which is one more reason all three pad grades come to the measure.
